answer_readings.1: The AI resolves the cause of the gate and continues the same run; never the gate itself.
answer_readings.2: All new config is default-off; without activation behavior is byte-identical to today. Silent means no operator or auto re-invoke; the segment handoff notification stays non-suppressible even under AUTO_QUIET=1.
answer_readings.3: Safety floor stays hard: no gate override, no .env read, no automatic npm publish or git push. pause_request exclusion is hard.
answer_readings.4: Self-resolve gates are per-gate comma-list (default empty); default set error, missing_input, decision_gate, security, publish. Budget gates: provider fallback, max one switch per run from the local catalog, then silent drain handoff. Drain off or no OPEN story stays a hard stop.
answer_readings.5: Shared US-0088/US-0092 stop matrix for /auto on Cursor and OpenCode; provider catalog from US-0101/DEC-0086, no hard vendor slug.
